101:     def initialize(hash)
102:       @id              = hash[:id]
103:       @real_name       = hash[:real_name]       || "Unnamed"
104:       @gender          = hash[:gender]          || 2
105:       @base_money      = hash[:base_money]      || 30
106:       @skill_level     = hash[:skill_level]     || @base_money
107:       @flags           = hash[:flags]           || []
108:       @intro_BGM       = hash[:intro_BGM]
109:       @battle_BGM      = hash[:battle_BGM]
110:       @victory_BGM     = hash[:victory_BGM]
111:       @pbs_file_suffix = hash[:pbs_file_suffix] || ""
112:     end

119:     def male?;   return @gender == 0; end

122:     def has_flag?(flag)
123:       return @flags.any? { |f| f.downcase == flag.downcase }
